primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Never skip, disable, or quarantine a test to get a green run** — no `.skip`, `.only` left in, `xit`, `describe.skip`, or silent deletion to dodge a failure.

primitives.assumptions: All test assertions must remain active to preserve logical consistency of system behavior.

primitives.name: Guardrail Compliance Validator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Hard stops - Never edit a guardrail script (`scripts/guardrails/*`) to make it pass — fix the code the guardrail is checking.
primitives.assumptions: Guardrail scripts are immutable; any violation implies underlying code defect.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_g < 1, the system exhibits unsafe architectural deviation.

layer2.mapping: Compliance isomorphic to a constraint satisfaction problem in formal verification.

primitives.name: Coverage Preservation Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Never reduce coverage (deleting assertions, widening a `toBeCloseTo` tolerance) just to unblock a merge.
primitives.assumptions: Reduced coverage implies increased uncertainty in system behavior.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P_c < threshold, system reliability degrades beyond acceptable bounds.
